rows = truth; columns = prediction:
[2, 1, 0]
[0, 1, 1]
[1, 0, 1]
class IoU: [0.5, 0.333333, 0.333333]
mean IoU: 0.388889
pixel accuracy: 0.571429

walkthrough.en: Skip an ignored ground-truth pixel before updating any row or column. Its prediction contributes nothing.
walkthrough.zh: 看到真值为忽略标签时，直接跳过；该位置的预测也不进入任何行列。

walkthrough.en: Read TP from the diagonal. The row total counts actual pixels; the column total counts predicted pixels.
walkthrough.zh: 对角线是 TP；行总数是真实像素数，列总数是预测像素数。

walkthrough.en: Union equals actual total plus predicted total minus TP. The subtraction avoids counting the intersection twice.
walkthrough.zh: 并集=真实总数+预测总数-TP，减法避免交集重复计数。

walkthrough.en: Average defined class IoUs equally. Return None for a class absent from both truth and prediction.
walkthrough.zh: 对有定义的类别 IoU 等权平均；若真值和预测都没有该类，则返回 None。

explanation.en:
IoU_c=TP_c/(TP_c+FP_c+FN_c). For background, TP=2, FP=1 and FN=1, so IoU=2/4=0.5. Road and object each have IoU=1/3. Mean IoU is (1/2+1/3+1/3)/3=7/18, about 0.388889. Pixel accuracy is instead 4/7. These metrics answer different questions.

The confusion matrix pools the evaluated pixels. Pooling all images before computing IoU can differ from averaging per-image IoUs. State which method you use. This implementation excludes a class only when its union is zero; a class missing from truth but predicted somewhere has nonzero union and IoU zero. Other benchmarks choose different absent-class conventions.

An all-ignored image gives no defined score. It is not a perfect prediction. For P pixels and C classes, this straightforward implementation takes O(P+C squared) time and O(C squared) storage. Keep the ignore mask, class mapping, pooling rule and resize method identical across models. Never resize discrete label masks with a method that creates fractional class IDs.
explanation.zh:
IoU_c=TP_c/(TP_c+FP_c+FN_c)。背景类 TP=2、FP=1、FN=1，因此 IoU=2/4=0.5；道路和物体均为 1/3。平均 IoU=(1/2+1/3+1/3)/3=7/18，约 0.388889；像素准确率则是 4/7，它们回答的问题不同。

本混淆矩阵汇总所有参与评估的像素。先汇总全部图像再算 IoU，与先逐图算 IoU 再平均，结果可能不同，必须说明采用哪种方式。本实现只在并集为零时排除类别；真值没有某类，但模型预测过它，该类并集非零，IoU 应为零。不同基准可能采用不同缺失类别规则。

全是忽略像素的图像没有有效分数，并不表示完美预测。P 个像素、C 个类别时，本直观实现花费 O(P+C²) 时间、O(C²) 空间。比较模型时，应固定忽略掩码、类别映射、汇总方式与缩放方法。离散标签掩码不能用会产生小数类别编号的方式缩放。

meaning.en: A pixel grid storing a selection or a class label.
meaning.zh: 保存选中状态或类别标签的像素网格。

meaning.en: The region selected as relevant to the task.
meaning.zh: 任务关注并选中的区域。

meaning.en: One individual object, such as one of three leaves.
meaning.zh: 一个独立物体，例如三片叶子中的一片。

question.en: Why can all-background accuracy be misleading?
question.zh: 为什么全背景准确率会误导？

answer.en: Most pixels may be background. Correct background decisions hide missed foreground objects.
answer.zh: 大部分像素可能是背景。正确背景判断会掩盖前景物体的遗漏。

question.en: Why is the code’s union four?
question.zh: 代码中的并集为何是四？

answer.en: Positions 0, 1, 2 and 3 appear in at least one mask. Positions 4 and 5 appear in neither.
answer.zh: 位置 0、1、2、3 至少被一个掩码选中，4、5 均未被选中。

question.en: Would two empty masks give IoU = 0/0?
question.zh: 两个空掩码是否产生 IoU=0/0？

answer.en: Yes, the raw formula is undefined. An evaluation must specify how that case is handled.
answer.zh: 是的，原始公式没有定义，评估必须明确处理方式。

question.en: Does an ignored pixel still count as a false positive?
question.zh: 忽略像素还算假阳性吗？

answer.en: Not under this protocol. We exclude that location entirely before counting. Document this rule so every model is evaluated on the same pixels.
answer.zh: 本规则下不算。我们在计数前完整排除该位置。应写明规则，保证所有模型在相同像素上评估。

body.en: Copy reference into prediction. Shared and union both become three, so IoU and Dice both become one.
body.zh: 让 prediction 与 reference 相同。交集、并集都为三，IoU 和 Dice 都为一。

body.en: Draw two leaves touching. A semantic leaf mask may join them; instance labels must still tell leaf A from leaf B.
body.zh: 画两片相接的叶子。语义叶片掩码可能连在一起；实例标签仍需区分叶 A 与叶 B。

story.en:
A school robotics team films two toy carts crossing a table. Detecting a cart in each frame is easy to describe, but counting each detection would count the same cart many times. Ana gives each cart a track number.

She predicts where an existing cart might move next, then pairs new detections with nearby tracks. When the carts cross, a nearest-position rule swaps their names. She keeps that clip as a test case and considers movement history. The team learns that tracking is a sequence problem: a plausible box in one frame does not by itself establish that it belongs to the same cart seen earlier.
story.zh:
学校机器人小组拍摄两辆玩具车穿过桌面。逐帧检测车容易描述，但若每个检测都计数，同一辆车会被重复统计。Ana 给每辆车分配轨迹编号。她先预测已有车下一刻的位置，再把新检测与邻近轨迹配对。

两车交叉时，最近位置规则交换了名称。她保留这段视频作为测试，并考虑运动历史。大家发现，跟踪是序列问题：单帧中合理的框本身无法证明它属于此前看到的同一辆车。

concept.en:
Detection supplies observations in each frame. Tracking links observations over time. A track stores an identity and a recent state, such as centre position and speed. Prediction moves that state forward before matching new detections.

In a simple one-dimensional model, speed is the position change per frame. Add speed to the last position to predict the next. Associate the nearest detection only if its distance is within a chosen gate. Real multi-object systems need one-to-one assignment so one detection does not update two tracks. SORT combines motion prediction with assignment; our arithmetic isolates only one track’s prediction and gate.
concept.zh:
检测提供每帧观察，跟踪把观察随时间连接起来。轨迹保存身份和近期状态，例如中心位置、速度。在匹配新检测前，预测先把状态向前推进。

简单一维模型中，速度是每帧位置变化。将速度加到上次位置，预测下一位置。只有最近检测的距离在指定门限内才关联。真实多物体系统需要一对一分配，防止同一检测更新两条轨迹。SORT 将运动预测与分配结合；本例只隔离一条轨迹的预测与门限。

topics.formula:
v = x_now − x_previous
x_predicted = x_now + v
match if |x_detection − x_predicted| ≤ gate

symbols.en: x values are horizontal centre positions measured in pixels. v is pixels per frame, assuming equally spaced frames. Vertical bars mean absolute value, so distance is nonnegative. gate is the largest allowed distance for this toy association.
symbols.zh: x 是以像素计的水平中心位置。v 是每帧移动像素数，假设帧间隔相等。竖线表示绝对值，因此距离非负。gate 是本例关联允许的最大距离。

calculation.en: A cart moves from x=2 to x=5, so v=3. The next prediction is 5+3=8. Detections at 8 and 15 are distances 0 and 7 from the prediction. With gate 2, choose 8. If the only detection were 15, leave the track unmatched instead of forcing a distant association.
calculation.zh:
车从 x=2 移到 x=5，所以 v=3。下一预测为 5+3=8。检测 8、15 与预测的距离为 0、7。

门限为 2 时选 8。若只有 15，就让轨迹暂时无匹配，不强行连接远处检测。

application.en: Tracking supports counting moving objects and following toy robots or wildlife through video. Inspect crossings, occlusion and missed detections.
application.zh: 跟踪可用于统计移动物体，或在视频中跟随玩具机器人和野生动物。应检查交叉、遮挡与漏检。

limits.en: Constant speed fails during sudden turns. Position alone does not resolve identical objects crossing. This example has one track and does not implement SORT’s state estimation or global assignment.
limits.zh: 恒定速度在突然转弯时失效，仅靠位置无法解决相同物体交叉。例子只有一条轨迹，没有实现 SORT 的状态估计或全局分配。

takeaway.en: Tracking supports counting moving objects and following toy robots or wildlife through video. Inspect crossings, occlusion and missed detections.
takeaway.zh: 跟踪可用于统计移动物体，或在视频中跟随玩具机器人和野生动物。应检查交叉、遮挡与漏检。

practice.en: Use the original calculation and Python below to inspect the mechanism. The linked primary sources explain how full systems extend it. The story is an invented teaching scenario.
practice.zh: 用下面的原创计算与 Python 代码观察机制。所链接的一手资料解释完整系统怎样扩展这些机制。故事是虚构的教学情境。

title.zh: 预测一条轨迹并设门限

intro.en: Use a single cart with equally spaced frames.
intro.zh: 使用等时间间隔帧中的一辆车。

code_examples.code:
previous, current = 2, 5
velocity = current - previous
predicted = current + velocity
detections = [8, 15]
nearest = min(detections, key=lambda x: abs(x - predicted))
accepted = abs(nearest - predicted) <= 2
print("predicted:", predicted)
print("nearest:", nearest, "accepted:", accepted)

explanation.en: Subtraction estimates speed; addition predicts the next centre. min searches the list. Its key is a small lambda function that returns absolute distance from the prediction, so it chooses the smallest distance rather than the smallest coordinate. <= tests the gate. The result accepts 8. This is a toy one-track association, not a trained tracker.
explanation.zh: 相减估计速度，相加预测下一个中心。min 搜索列表。key 是一个返回距预测绝对距离的 lambda 小函数，因此选的是最小距离而非最小坐标。<= 检查门限。结果接受 8。这是单轨迹关联示例，不是训练好的跟踪器。

meaning.en: An identity and changing state linked across frames.
meaning.zh: 跨帧连接的身份及变化状态。

meaning.en: Pairing a new detection with an existing track.
meaning.zh: 将新检测与已有轨迹配对。

meaning.en: An object is partly or fully hidden from the camera.
meaning.zh: 物体被部分或完全遮住。

question.en: Why predict before matching?
question.zh: 为什么先预测再匹配？

answer.en: A moving object is expected to leave its old position. Prediction gives a more relevant comparison point.
answer.zh: 移动物体预计会离开旧位置。预测提供更合适的比较点。

question.en: Why predict eight?
question.zh: 为什么预测八？

answer.en: The last change is 5−2=3; adding the same change to 5 gives 8.
answer.zh: 上次变化是 5−2=3；向 5 加相同变化得到 8。

question.en: What if no detection passes the gate?
question.zh: 没有检测通过门限怎么办？

answer.en: Record a missing observation. A full tracker may keep a prediction briefly, but should not invent a confirmed sighting.
answer.zh: 记录观察缺失。完整跟踪器可短暂保留预测，但不应把它当作已确认观察。

body.en: Set detections to [4,15]. The nearest is 4 but distance 4 exceeds the gate. The rule rejects it even if the cart truly turned.
body.zh: 把检测改为 [4,15]。最近为 4，但距离 4 超过门限。即使车真的转向，规则也会拒绝。

body.en: Sketch two predicted centres and two detections. Enforce one detection per track before deciding identities; independent nearest choices can collide.
body.zh: 画两个预测中心与两个检测。确认身份前应要求每个检测只分给一条轨迹，独立最近选择可能冲突。

title.en: OCR: turn visible marks into text

story.en:
The library club scans shelf labels so books can be found by typing a code. One photograph is tilted, and the letter O is read as zero. Noah first straightens the crop and checks whether the characters have enough pixels.

He then compares the read text with the visible label, keeping the crop beside the result. A spelling rule helps for ordinary words but would damage unusual catalogue codes, so he leaves those for review. The corrected workflow treats reading as several connected decisions: find the text, prepare it, recognise the symbols and check whether the result fits the evidence. A readable sentence alone does not prove a faithful transcription.
story.zh:
图书社扫描书架标签，希望输入编号就能查书。一张照片倾斜，字母 O 被读成数字零。Noah 先校正裁剪图，再检查每个字符是否有足够像素。他把识别文字与可见标签比较，并把小图保留在结果旁。

拼写规则有助于普通词，却可能破坏特殊书目编号，所以编号留待复核。改进后的流程把读字当作多个相关判断：找文字、准备图像、识别符号、核对证据。一个通顺句子本身并不能证明转写忠实。

concept.en:
Optical character recognition, or OCR, turns text in images into characters. A common pipeline detects text regions, corrects rotation, recognises characters or sequences, then checks output order. Page layout matters: reading two columns as one line changes the message.

A small template matcher teaches the recognition step. Store a binary pattern for each candidate symbol. Compare an observed pattern to each template and count positions that differ. The smallest mismatch count wins. Full OCR systems learn much richer shape and language patterns, and must handle variable fonts, spacing and image quality.
concept.zh:
光学字符识别 OCR 把图像文字转为字符。常见流程先检测文字区域，再校正旋转、识别字符或序列，最后检查输出顺序。页面布局很重要：把两栏当成一行会改变内容。

小型模板匹配可讲解识别步骤。为每个候选符号存一个二值图案，再比较观察图案与每个模板，统计不同位置。差异最少者获选。完整 OCR 系统学习丰富得多的形状和语言模式，还要处理字体、间距与图像质量变化。

topics.formula:
mismatch(pattern, template) = number of unequal positions
chosen_label = label with the smallest mismatch

symbols.en: A pattern is a fixed-length list of zeros and ones read row by row from a tiny image. A template is a stored reference list of the same size. Each unequal position contributes one; equal positions contribute zero. This is Hamming distance for binary patterns.
symbols.zh: pattern 是从小图逐行读取的固定长度零一列表。template 是相同大小的参考列表。每个不同位置贡献一，相同位置贡献零。这是二值图案的汉明距离。

calculation.en: Use seven positions. A toy H template is [1,0,1,1,1,0,1], and an I template is [0,1,0,1,0,1,0]. The observed [1,0,1,1,1,0,0] differs from H only at the last position, so distance is 1. It differs from I at five positions. H is closer under this toy encoding.
calculation.zh: 使用七个位置。H 教学模板为 [1,0,1,1,1,0,1]，I 为 [0,1,0,1,0,1,0]。观察值 [1,0,1,1,1,0,0] 只在末位与 H 不同，距离为 1；与 I 有五处不同。因此在该教学编码下 H 更接近。

application.en: OCR supports searchable scans, labels and document reading. Preserve the image region and reading order so users can check uncertain text.
application.zh: OCR 可用于扫描件搜索、标签识别与文档阅读。应保留原图区域及阅读顺序，便于核对不确定文字。

limits.en: The seven-bit patterns are invented teaching codes, not actual font images. The nearest template always exists even for unreadable input. Unknown symbols and ties need an explicit review option.
limits.zh: 七位图案是虚构教学编码，不是真实字形图像。即使输入不可读，也总会有最近模板。未知符号与平局需要明确复核选项。

takeaway.en: OCR supports searchable scans, labels and document reading. Preserve the image region and reading order so users can check uncertain text.
takeaway.zh: OCR 可用于扫描件搜索、标签识别与文档阅读。应保留原图区域及阅读顺序，便于核对不确定文字。

practice.en: Use the original calculation and Python below to inspect the mechanism. The linked primary sources explain how full systems extend it. The story is an invented teaching scenario.
practice.zh: 用下面的原创计算与 Python 代码观察机制。所链接的一手资料解释完整系统怎样扩展这些机制。故事是虚构的教学情境。

intro.en: Compare invented binary symbol patterns; this is not Tesseract or a trained OCR model.
intro.zh: 比较虚构二值符号图案；不是 Tesseract，也不是训练 OCR 模型。

explanation.en: The dictionary stores one list per label. The loop pairs observed and template positions with zip; != is True when they differ. sum counts these True values. distances.get supplies each label’s distance to min, which selects H. Equal lengths are assumed here; a real input check must enforce them. No text region detection is implemented.
explanation.zh: 字典为每个标签保存列表。循环用 zip 配对观察值与模板位置；不等时 != 返回 True，sum 统计 True。distances.get 将每个标签的距离提供给 min，最终选 H。这里假定长度相等，真实输入应检查。未实现文字区域检测。

meaning.en: Converting visible text in an image into character data.
meaning.zh: 把图像中的可见文字变为字符数据。

meaning.en: A stored example used for comparison.
meaning.zh: 用于比较的已存参考样本。

meaning.en: The order in which page regions should be read.
meaning.zh: 页面各区域应被阅读的次序。

question.en: Why retain the crop?
question.zh: 为什么保留裁剪小图？

answer.en: It provides direct evidence for checking whether a symbol was read correctly.
answer.zh: 它提供核对符号是否读对的直接证据。

question.en: Why is H’s distance one?
question.zh: 为什么 H 的距离是一？

answer.en: Only the seventh position differs; the other six agree.
answer.zh: 只有第七位不同，其他六位相同。

question.en: Can a dictionary always correct O versus 0?
question.zh: 词典总能纠正 O 与 0 吗？

answer.en: No. A shelf code may legitimately contain either, so language plausibility is not enough.
answer.zh: 不能。书架编号可能合法地包含其中任一种，语言合理性并不足够。

body.en: Try an all-zero observation and inspect both distances. Add a maximum allowed mismatch before accepting any label.
body.zh: 试全零观察值并检查两个距离。接受标签前添加最大允许差异数。

body.en: Write two short columns on paper. Compare row-wise reading with column-wise reading. Correct individual characters do not guarantee correct sentence order.
body.zh: 在纸上写两栏短文字。比较按行读与按栏读。单个字符正确不保证句子顺序正确。

story.en:
Mateo builds a teaching display that sorts photographs of handmade kites. A stripe near a corner matters only together with the tail. He draws a grid over each photograph and represents every square with a short list of numbers. The model can let these lists exchange information before choosing a label.

Mateo first thinks that halving each square’s width will only double the work. He counts again: the picture now has four times as many squares, and far more pairs can compare. He displays these counts beside the examples. The lesson now shows both why distant regions can interact and why keeping finer detail can require more computation.
story.zh:
Mateo 制作一个按样式分类手工风筝照片的教学展示。角落条纹只有与尾部一起看才有意义。他在照片上画网格，用短数字列表表示每格，让这些列表在模型选标签前交换信息。

他起初以为每格宽度减半只会让工作加倍。重新计数才发现格数增至四倍，可比较的配对更多。他把计数放在例子旁。课程因此同时说明远处区域为何能交互，以及保留更细细节为何可能需要更多计算。

concept.en:
A visual token is a list of numbers representing one image piece. Start by cutting the image into equal patches. Flattening reads each patch’s channel values into one long list without adding information. A learned projection uses weighted sums to turn this list into a fixed number of features.

The original Vision Transformer adds position information and one class token. Self-attention lets each token compare with other tokens and mix their information. The class token gathers information used for classification. A patch is a grid region; it does not have to contain one whole object.

With L tokens, full attention considers L choices of source and L choices of destination: L×L pairs. Smaller patches give more detail but many more comparisons. This count describes one part of the model. It is not a direct promise about total runtime or memory on every implementation.
concept.zh:
视觉词元是一组表示图像局部的数字。先把图像切成等大图像块。展平按顺序把块内通道值读成一个长列表，不会添加信息。学习得到的投影通过加权和，把长列表转成固定数量的特征。

原始 Vision Transformer 加入位置信息和一个类别词元。自注意力让每个词元与其他词元比较并混合信息。类别词元汇集分类所需的信息。图像块只是网格区域，不一定包含一个完整物体。

有 L 个词元时，全注意力考虑 L 个来源和 L 个目标，因此有 L×L 对。更小的块提供更多细节，也增加许多比较。这个计数只描述模型的一部分，不能直接保证所有实现的总运行时间或内存。

application.en: Before choosing image resolution and patch size, calculate the patch count and the sequence length including special tokens. Check whether the image dimensions divide evenly or require an explicit resizing or padding policy. Compare detail retention against measured resource use, and preserve the pretrained model's positional handling. For a new task, inspect whether useful evidence is lost during resizing before attributing every error to attention.
application.zh: 选择图像分辨率与图像块大小之前，先计算图像块数量，以及包括特殊词元在内的序列长度。检查图像尺寸能否整除，还是需要明确的缩放或填充规则。比较细节保留程度与实际资源消耗，并遵循预训练模型的位置处理方式。对于新任务，先检查缩放是否丢失有用证据，再分析注意力是否造成了错误。

practice.en: The original ViT paper demonstrates image classification by combining projected patches with a transformer encoder and studies transfer after large-scale pretraining. TorchVision's VisionTransformer implementation makes patch projection and the added class token inspectable. The original Transformer paper explains the attention operation underlying this exchange. These sources support the design being illustrated; the handmade-kite display and its small numerical example are original teaching scenarios.
practice.zh: 原始 ViT 论文通过投影后的图像块与 Transformer 编码器完成图像分类，并研究大规模预训练后的迁移。TorchVision 的 VisionTransformer 实现使图像块投影和额外类别词元可以直接检查。原始 Transformer 论文解释了这种信息交换背后的注意力运算。这些资料支持这里介绍的设计；手工风筝展示及其小型数值例子是原创教学情景。

topics.formula:
patch_count = (H / P) × (W / P)
values_per_patch = P × P × C
L = patch_count + 1
pair_count = L × L

symbols.en: H and W are image height and width in pixels. P is the side length of one square patch; here it divides both image dimensions exactly. C counts colour channels. L is the number of tokens after adding one class token, a learned summary slot used in the original Vision Transformer. pair_count counts every ordered token pair for one full-attention head. A head is one set of comparison and mixing operations.
symbols.zh: H、W 是像素高度与宽度。P 是正方形图像块的边长，这里假设能整除图像尺寸。C 是颜色通道数。L 是加上一个类别词元后的词元数；类别词元是原始 Vision Transformer 使用的可学习汇总位置。pair_count 为一个全注意力头统计所有有顺序的词元对。一个头是一组比较与混合操作。

calculation.en:
A 32×32 RGB image divided into 8×8 patches has 4 patches along each side, so 4×4=16 patches. Each contains 8×8×3=192 channel values. A learned projection can convert each 192-number list into, for example, 64 feature numbers by computing 64 different weighted sums.

One added class token gives L=17, so full attention has 17×17=289 pairs per head. Using 4×4 patches gives 8×8=64 patches, 65 tokens and 65²=4225 pairs. The ratio is 4225/289≈14.62. This counts comparisons in an attention component; it does not predict the same multiplier for complete runtime.
calculation.zh:
32×32 的 RGB 图切成 8×8 块，每边四块，共 4×4=16 块。每块有 8×8×3=192 个通道值。学习投影可计算 64 种加权和，将每个 192 数列表转为例如 64 个特征数。

加入一个类别词元后 L=17，全注意力每头有 17×17=289 对。改用 4×4 块时，有 8×8=64 块、65 词元、65²=4225 对。倍率为 4225/289≈14.62。这是注意力部分的比较计数，不表示完整运行时间有相同倍率。

limits.en: The exchange-of-descriptions analogy does not mean tokens reason like people or that attention weights explain every decision. The simplified arithmetic concerns ordinary full attention with fixed embedding width. Other architectures can use windows, pooling or different token designs, and finer patches alone do not guarantee better recognition.
limits.zh: 交换描述的类比，并不意味着词元像人一样推理，也不意味着注意力权重可以解释每次判断。简化计算针对嵌入宽度固定的普通全注意力。其他架构可以使用窗口、池化或不同词元设计，而更细的图像块本身也不保证识别更好。

takeaway.en: Count patches and special tokens explicitly: finer visual units increase possible interactions, while useful detail and actual runtime still require measurement.
takeaway.zh: 明确计算图像块与特殊词元：更细的视觉单元会增加可能的交互，而有用细节与实际运行时间仍需测量。

title.zh: 统计图像块与比较次数

intro.en: Compare two patch sizes before considering a full model.
intro.zh: 先比较两种块大小，再考虑完整模型。

code_examples.code:
height, width, channels = 32, 32, 3
for patch_size in [8, 4]:
    patches = (height // patch_size) * (width // patch_size)
    values = patch_size * patch_size * channels
    tokens = patches + 1
    print(f"P={patch_size}: patches={patches}, values={values}, pairs={tokens ** 2}")
code_examples.output:
P=8: patches=16, values=192, pairs=289
P=4: patches=64, values=48, pairs=4225

explanation.en: The first line assigns three size variables. The loop repeats the same calculation for patch sizes 8 and 4. // is whole-number division; here both sizes divide evenly. Add one token for the class summary. **2 means multiply the token count by itself. We count 289 and 4225 pairs; we do not implement attention, learned projection or a trained transformer.
explanation.zh: 第一行给三个尺寸变量赋值。循环对边长 8 与 4 重复计算。// 是整数除法，这里尺寸都能整除。加一是类别汇总词元。**2 表示词元数乘自身。得到 289、4225 对；并未实现注意力、学习投影或训练好的 Transformer。

meaning.en: A small grid region cut from an image.
meaning.zh: 从图像切出的一个小网格区域。

meaning.en: One numerical unit processed in a sequence.
meaning.zh: 序列中被处理的一个数值单元。

meaning.en: Weighted sums that convert one feature list to another size.
meaning.zh: 用加权和把特征列表转换到另一种大小。

meaning.en: Mixing information among tokens in the same sequence.
meaning.zh: 在同一序列的词元之间混合信息。

question.en: Why keep patch positions?
question.zh: 为什么保留块的位置？

answer.en: The same patches in another arrangement can describe a different scene. Order carries spatial evidence.
answer.zh: 相同图像块以不同方式排列可能形成另一场景。位置顺序携带空间证据。

question.en: How many values are inside an 8×8 RGB patch?
question.zh: 8×8 的 RGB 块里有多少数？

answer.en: 8×8×3 = 192; each of 64 pixels stores three channel values.
answer.zh: 8×8×3=192；64 个像素各有三个通道值。

question.en: Does four times as many patches mean four times as many pairs?
question.zh: 块数四倍是否意味着比较对数四倍？

answer.en: No. Pair count squares the token count. Here the added class token gives 4225/289 ≈ 14.62 times.
answer.zh: 不是。比较对数对词元数平方。这里因额外类别词元，倍率为 4225/289≈14.62。

body.en: Consider a small sign that fits inside one large patch. Smaller patches may preserve more useful detail but raise the comparison budget. Evaluate both reading quality and cost.
body.zh: 考虑一块落在大图像块内部的小标牌。小块可能保留更多细节，也增加比较量。需要同时评估读字质量与成本。

body.en: Remove the +1 to model a variant that pools patch outputs instead. For P=8 there are 16 tokens and 256 pairs. This is a different design.
body.zh: 去掉 +1，模拟对图像块输出汇总的变体。P=8 时有 16 个词元、256 对。这属于不同设计。

title.zh: 缺陷检查：发现异常区域

story.en:
A ceramics club photographs tiles made in class. Most are smooth, while a few contain dark chips. Elena first compares each photograph with a typical clean tile. One region differs strongly and deserves a closer look.

But a lamp moved between sessions also makes an undamaged tile look unusual. She fixes the camera and light, checks which differences remain, and marks suspicious regions for a person to inspect. The team avoids calling every unusual pixel a defect. Their comparison now has a clear job: suggest where to look, while examples of real chips and harmless variation determine whether the suggestion is useful.
story.zh:
陶艺社拍摄课堂制作的瓷片。大多数平整，少数有暗色缺口。Elena 先将每张照片与典型完好瓷片比较，一个区域差异很大，值得仔细看。但两次拍摄间台灯移动，也让完好瓷片显得异常。

她固定相机与灯光，查看剩余差异，再将可疑区域交给人检查。团队不再把每个异常像素都叫缺陷。比较有了明确任务：建议看哪里；真实缺口与无害变化样本则用来判断建议是否有用。

concept.en:
A defect is a task-defined problem, such as a chip on a tile. An anomaly is something unlike the reference data. They are not identical: an unfamiliar but harmless design is also unusual. In anomaly detection, a system may learn typical appearances from normal examples and score deviations.

Our simplest baseline uses absolute differences between an aligned observation and a reference. A threshold turns that difference map into candidate regions. Real systems often compare learned features instead of raw pixels. Evaluate both image-level alerts and the location of suspicious regions, using separately collected normal and defective examples.
concept.zh:
缺陷是任务定义的问题，例如瓷片缺口。异常是与参考数据不同的情况。两者不相同：陌生但无害的花纹也可能异常。异常检测系统可从正常样本学习典型外观，再对偏离程度评分。

最简单基线对对齐后的观察图与参考图逐点求绝对差，再用阈值把差值图变成候选区域。真实系统常比较学习特征而非原始像素。应使用独立采集的正常及缺陷样本，同时评估整图警报与可疑区域位置。

topics.formula:
dᵢ = |observedᵢ − referenceᵢ|
flagᵢ = dᵢ > threshold
image_score = max(d₁, …, dₙ)

symbols.en: i selects one corresponding pixel or feature. dᵢ is its nonnegative absolute difference. n is the number of compared positions. max chooses the largest difference. A flag is a yes/no decision. All values must share the same scale and be spatially aligned.
symbols.zh: i 选择一个对应像素或特征。dᵢ 是其非负绝对差。n 为比较位置数。max 取最大差。flag 是是或否判断。所有值必须使用同一尺度，并在空间上对齐。

calculation.en: Reference [10,10,10,10] and observation [11,9,25,10] give differences [1,1,15,0]. A threshold of 5 flags only position 2 when indexing from zero. The image score is 15. If lighting adds 8 to every value, all four positions may be flagged despite no local chip.
calculation.zh: 参考 [10,10,10,10] 与观察 [11,9,25,10] 得到差 [1,1,15,0]。阈值 5 只标记从零计数的位置 2，整图分数为 15。若光照给每个值都加 8，即使没有局部缺口，也可能四处都被标记。

application.en: Use anomaly maps as inspection aids for textures or objects. Keep a distinction between unusual appearance and a confirmed defect.
application.zh: 可用异常图辅助检查纹理或物体。必须区分异常外观与已确认缺陷。

limits.en: Pixel differences are sensitive to alignment and light. MVTec AD is a research dataset for industrial anomaly detection, not evidence that this tiny rule meets an inspection requirement.
limits.zh: 像素差对对齐和光照敏感。MVTec AD 是工业异常检测研究数据集，不能证明这个小规则满足实际检测要求。

takeaway.en: Use anomaly maps as inspection aids for textures or objects. Keep a distinction between unusual appearance and a confirmed defect.
takeaway.zh: 可用异常图辅助检查纹理或物体。必须区分异常外观与已确认缺陷。

practice.en: Use the original calculation and Python below to inspect the mechanism. The linked primary sources explain how full systems extend it. The story is an invented teaching scenario.
practice.zh: 用下面的原创计算与 Python 代码观察机制。所链接的一手资料解释完整系统怎样扩展这些机制。故事是虚构的教学情境。

intro.en: A four-position strip isolates the idea of a deviation map.
intro.zh: 用四位置窄条单独说明差异图。

code_examples.code:
reference = [10, 10, 10, 10]
observed = [11, 9, 25, 10]
differences = [abs(x - r) for x, r in zip(observed, reference)]
flagged = [i for i, value in enumerate(differences) if value > 5]
print("differences:", differences)
print("flagged positions:", flagged)
print("image score:", max(differences))

explanation.en: zip pairs aligned positions. abs removes the sign of each difference. The second list comprehension uses enumerate to retain position numbers and if to keep only values above 5. max gives score 15. A high difference identifies a candidate for review, not a proven defect. This is an untrained baseline with a hand-set reference.
explanation.zh: zip 配对对齐位置。abs 去掉差值符号。第二个列表推导式用 enumerate 保留位置编号，用 if 仅留下大于 5 的值。max 得分 15。高差异只表明复核候选，不证明存在缺陷。这是使用手设参考的未训练基线。

meaning.en: An observation unlike the reference examples.
meaning.zh: 与参考样本不同的观察。

meaning.en: A problem defined by the actual inspection task.
meaning.zh: 由实际检查任务定义的问题。

meaning.en: A simple method used as a comparison point.
meaning.zh: 作为比较起点的简单方法。

question.en: Why separate anomaly from defect?
question.zh: 为什么区分异常与缺陷？

answer.en: A new harmless pattern can be unusual, while a subtle defect may look familiar.
answer.zh: 新的无害图案可以很异常，细微缺陷也可能看着熟悉。

question.en: Why flag position two?
question.zh: 为什么标记位置二？

answer.en: Its difference is |25−10|=15, the only difference above 5.
answer.zh: 该处 |25−10|=15，是唯一超过 5 的差。

question.en: Would a brighter lamp cause alerts?
question.zh: 更亮的灯会触发警报吗？

answer.en: Yes. A global brightness change affects raw pixel differences even without damage.
answer.zh: 会。即使没有损伤，全局亮度变化也影响原始像素差。

body.en: Use observed=[12,11,9,10]. Differences are [2,1,1,0], so this threshold produces no alert.
body.zh: 使用 observed=[12,11,9,10]。差为 [2,1,1,0]，该阈值不发警报。

body.en: Use observed=[18,18,18,18]. Every position is flagged. Explain why controlled capture matters before tuning a model.
body.zh: 使用 observed=[18,18,18,18]。每个位置都被标记。说明为何调模型前需要控制拍摄条件。

title.en: Test on the next capture, not a familiar neighbour
title.zh: 用下一次采集检验，而非只看熟悉的邻帧

story.en:
A wildlife club trains a camera-image filter and celebrates a high test score. Sam notices that neighbouring frames from the same camera burst appear in both training and test folders. The test pictures are new files, but almost copies of pictures already seen.

Sam groups each burst together and holds out entire camera locations for a separate check. The score falls, especially at night. He counts correct alerts, false alerts and missed animals instead of reporting only one percentage. The revised test is harder, but answers a useful question about a new camera. It also points to the conditions where the club needs more examples or human review.
story.zh:
野生动物社训练相机图像筛选器，并庆祝很高测试分。Sam 发现同一次连拍的相邻帧同时出现在训练与测试文件夹。测试虽是新文件，却几乎是已见图片的副本。

他将每次连拍放在同组，并另外留出整处相机位置检查。分数下降，尤其是夜间。他统计正确警报、错误警报与漏掉动物，不再只给百分比。新测试更难，却能回答新相机上的实用问题，也指出哪些条件需要更多例子或人工复核。

concept.en:
Evaluation asks how a system behaves on examples it did not learn from. Split data into training examples used to adjust weights, validation examples used to choose settings, and a final test set used to report results. Keep near-duplicates and related capture sessions together. Otherwise the test may look familiar even if its file names are new.

Choose groups to match future use. To test a new camera, hold out cameras. To test new objects, hold out object identities. A change in lighting, viewpoint or camera between training and use is a domain shift. A good result in one setting may not carry to another.

For a yes/no task, a true positive is a correct alert. A false positive is an incorrect alert. A false negative is a missed item. Precision asks what fraction of alerts are correct. Recall asks what fraction of real items were found. Report the counts as well as fractions and inspect important conditions separately.
concept.zh:
评估考察系统面对没有学过的样本时的表现。训练集用于调整权重，验证集用于选择设置，最终测试集用于报告结果。近似重复图像和相关拍摄场次应放在同一部分。否则即使文件名是新的，测试内容也可能早已熟悉。

分组应符合未来使用情境。测试新相机时留出整台相机的数据，测试新物体时按物体身份留出。训练与使用之间的光照、视角或相机变化称为领域偏移。一种条件下表现好，不代表另一条件也好。

对于是或否任务，真正例是正确警报，假正例是错误警报，假负例是漏检。精确率问警报中多少正确，召回率问真实目标中找到多少。要同时报告计数与比例，并单独检查重要条件。

application.en: Write the future-use question before constructing a split: new frames from familiar cameras, new sessions, or new locations require different evidence. Group related captures accordingly and preserve a final test set. Select thresholds on validation data, inspect errors by relevant conditions, and report both aggregate and group-level counts. Treat a new environment as something to measure explicitly rather than assuming one pooled score transfers unchanged.
application.zh: 划分数据前，先写清未来使用问题：熟悉相机的新帧、新采集时段，或全新地点，需要不同证据。据此对相关采集记录分组，并保留最终测试集。用验证数据选择阈值，按相关条件检查错误，同时报告总体与各组的计数。应明确测量新环境中的表现，而不是假设一个汇总分数能够原样迁移。

practice.en: The WILDS research benchmark includes wildlife monitoring shifts across camera traps, giving a documented example of why image source matters. Scikit-learn's GroupKFold documentation shows how group identities can remain separate across training and test folds. Its evaluation guide defines precision and recall. These sources motivate capture-aware evaluation; a grouped split alone does not establish robustness to every future camera or season.
practice.zh: WILDS 研究基准包含野生动物监测中跨野外自动相机的分布偏移，提供了图像来源为何重要的具体记录。scikit-learn 的 GroupKFold 文档展示如何在训练折与测试折之间保持组身份分离，其评估指南则定义了精确率与召回率。这些资料支持考虑采集来源的评估方式；单凭分组划分，仍不能证明模型能适应未来每一台相机或每一个季节。

topics.formula:
Precision = TP / (TP + FP)
Recall = TP / (TP + FN)
F₁ = 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN)

symbols.en: TP means true positive: an image with wildlife that correctly triggers an alert. FP means false positive: an empty image that incorrectly triggers an alert. FN means false negative: a wildlife image that was missed. These count images, not pixels or boxes. F₁ combines precision and recall; its displayed count formula avoids needing a new averaging rule. Keep the decision threshold fixed when comparing these counts. If a denominator is zero, state how the metric is handled and report the counts.
symbols.zh: TP 是真正例：有野生动物且正确警报的图。FP 是假正例：空图却错误警报。FN 是假负例：有动物却漏掉的图。这里数图像，不数像素或框。F₁ 组合精确率和召回率；给出的计数公式无需先学另一平均规则。比较时应固定决策阈值。若分母为零，要说明指标怎样处理并报告计数。

calculation.en:
Suppose a synthetic held-out group contains 100 images: 20 show wildlife and 80 are empty. At the chosen threshold, the model flags 25 images. Of these, 15 contain wildlife, so TP = 15 and FP = 10. It misses five wildlife images, giving FN = 5.

Precision is 15 / 25 = 0.60, recall is 15 / 20 = 0.75, and F₁ is 30 / 45, approximately 0.6667. The remaining 70 empty images are correctly rejected. Overall accuracy is therefore 85 / 100 = 85%, but that number alone hides the ten false alerts and five misses. These counts describe this sampled group at this threshold, not a guarantee about an unseen camera location.
calculation.zh:
假设一个自拟留出组包含 100 张图片，其中 20 张有野生动物，80 张为空场景。在选定阈值下，模型对 25 张图片发出提示，其中 15 张确有动物，因此 TP = 15、FP = 10。它漏掉了 5 张有动物的图片，所以 FN = 5。精确率为 15 / 25 = 0.60，召回率为 15 / 20 = 0.75，F₁ 为 30 / 45，约为 0.6667。

其余 70 张空场景被正确排除。因此总体准确率为 85 / 100 = 85%，但单看这个数字，会掩盖十次误报与五次漏报。这些计数描述的是该抽样组在该阈值下的表现，不能保证模型在未见过的相机地点上也有同样表现。

limits.en: The unfamiliar-photograph analogy helps expose leakage, but novelty has several dimensions. Separate sessions may still share the same camera background, and new locations can change class frequencies. Small evaluation groups produce uncertain estimates; always retain sample counts and avoid interpreting a single split as a universal performance certificate.
limits.zh: 陌生照片的类比有助于发现泄漏，但陌生程度有多个维度。不同采集时段仍可能共享同一相机背景，新地点也可能改变类别频率。小评估组的估计具有不确定性；应始终保留样本数量，避免把一次划分当成通用性能证明。

takeaway.en: A trustworthy vision score names its population, separates related captures, and reveals the false positives and missed positives behind the average.
takeaway.zh: 可信的视觉分数应明确目标总体，隔离相关采集记录，并揭示平均值背后的误报与漏报。

intro.en: Calculate metrics from explicit counts for one held-out group.
intro.zh: 从一个留出组的明确计数计算指标。

code_examples.code:
true_positive, false_positive, false_negative = 15, 10, 5
precision = true_positive / (true_positive + false_positive)
recall = true_positive / (true_positive + false_negative)
f1 = 2 * true_positive / (2 * true_positive + false_positive + false_negative)
print(f"precision={precision:.2f}; recall={recall:.2f}; F1={f1:.4f}")
sessions = {"train": {"morning-A", "evening-A"}, "test": {"morning-B"}}
print("shared sessions:", len(sessions["train"] & sessions["test"]))

explanation.en: The first line assigns the three error counts. Each division uses the population named by its metric. A dictionary maps split names to sets of capture-session names. & finds set intersection; len reports zero shared sessions. This verifies one chosen grouping rule, not every possible source of leakage. There is no model training here.
explanation.zh: 第一行设置三种计数。每个除法使用该指标对应的总体。字典将划分名称映射到拍摄场次集合。& 求集合交集，len 报告共享场次为零。这只检查一种分组规则，不能排除所有可能的泄漏。这里没有模型训练。

meaning.en: Correct alerts divided by all alerts.
meaning.zh: 正确警报数除以全部警报数。

meaning.en: Found real items divided by all real items.
meaning.zh: 找到的真实目标数除以全部真实目标数。

meaning.en: Test information reaches model development and makes evaluation misleading.
meaning.zh: 测试信息进入模型开发，使评估产生误导。

meaning.en: The data conditions change between development and use.
meaning.zh: 开发与使用时的数据条件不同。

question.en: Why group adjacent video frames?
question.zh: 为什么把相邻视频帧放在同一组？

answer.en: They share much of the scene. Splitting them can measure recognition of a near-copy instead of generalization.
answer.zh: 它们共享大量场景。拆开后可能测到的是识别近似副本，而非泛化。

question.en: Why is recall 15/20?
question.zh: 召回率为什么是 15/20？

answer.en: There are 15 found animals and 5 missed animals, so 20 actual positive images.
answer.zh: 找到 15 张动物图、漏掉 5 张，因此真实正例共 20 张。

question.en: Would twice as many false alerts change recall?
question.zh: 错误警报翻倍会改变召回率吗？

answer.en: With true positives and misses fixed, recall stays 0.75. Precision drops to 15/35 ≈ 0.4286.
answer.zh: 若真正例和漏检数不变，召回率仍是 0.75。精确率降为 15/35≈0.4286。

body.en: Put morning-A in the test set too. The shared-session count becomes one. Remove that overlap before interpreting a test score.
body.zh: 把 morning-A 也放入测试集。共享场次计数变为一。解释测试分数前先消除重叠。

body.en: Report separate day and night counts. An excellent daytime average cannot establish night-time reliability when few night images were tested.
body.zh: 分别报告白天与夜晚计数。若夜间测试图很少，优秀白天均值不能证明夜间可靠。

title.en: Inference pipelines: preserve the whole journey
title.zh: 推理流程：检查完整处理过程

story.en:
The robotics club finishes a small image model and tries it on a slower laptop. The arithmetic inside the model is quick, yet each result arrives late. Imani measures the whole trip: resizing the image, running the model and converting boxes back to the original picture.

She also discovers that a score threshold was changed on only one computer. The club writes one shared input and output specification, then compares accuracy before and after a smaller numeric representation is used. They keep the faster version only if it passes their checked examples. Speed becomes something to measure alongside correctness, rather than a reason to skip it.
story.zh:
机器人社做完一个小图像模型，在较慢笔电上试用。模型内部计算很快，结果却总是很迟。Imani 测量完整过程：调整图像大小、运行模型、把框转回原图。她还发现只有一台电脑改了分数阈值。

社团写下统一输入输出规范，再比较使用较小数值表示前后的准确性。只有通过核实样本才保留快版本。速度变成与正确性一起测量的目标，而不是跳过正确性检查的理由。

concept.en:
Inference means using fixed model weights to make a prediction. A pipeline includes preprocessing, model computation and postprocessing. Its output is correct only if these steps agree on channels, sizes, coordinates and thresholds.

Latency is the delay for one request. Throughput is how many requests finish per second. They are different: batching can improve throughput while making one request wait. Quantization stores or computes numbers with fewer possible values. It can reduce cost on suitable hardware, but rounding changes numbers and may change decisions. Always re-evaluate the complete pipeline after an optimisation.
concept.zh:
推理是使用固定模型权重作预测。流程包括预处理、模型计算和后处理。只有这些步骤在通道、尺寸、坐标、阈值上保持一致，输出才可能正确。

延迟是一个请求等待的时间，吞吐量是每秒完成多少请求。两者不同：批处理可能提高吞吐量，同时让某个请求等待更久。量化使用更少种可能数值存储或计算。合适硬件上可降低成本，但舍入会改数，也可能改变决策。优化后必须重新评估完整流程。

topics.formula:
quantized = round(value / step)
restored = quantized × step
error = |restored − value|
serial_latency = preprocess_time + model_time + postprocess_time

symbols.en: step is the spacing between representable values in a simple zero-offset quantizer. round picks the nearest integer; this toy omits clipping and data-type limits. error is the absolute change. The latency sum assumes the three stages run one after another without overlap, in the same time unit.
symbols.zh: step 是简单零偏移量化器可表示数值的间隔。round 取最近整数；本例忽略裁剪与数据类型限制。error 是绝对变化。延迟求和假设三步骤依次运行、不重叠，并使用相同时间单位。

calculation.en: For value 0.26 and step 0.1, 0.26/0.1=2.6 rounds to 3. Restoring gives 0.3, with error 0.04. Times of 4, 7 and 2 milliseconds sum to 13 milliseconds. If only model time drops to 4, total delay becomes 10, not half of 13.
calculation.zh: value=0.26、step=0.1 时，0.26/0.1=2.6，舍入为 3，恢复为 0.3，误差 0.04。4、7、2 毫秒的阶段时间相加为 13 毫秒。若只有模型时间降为 4，总延迟为 10，而非 13 的一半。

application.en: Build reproducible preprocessing and postprocessing around a model. Compare output quality, latency and memory using the actual intended inputs.
application.zh: 围绕模型建立可复现的预处理与后处理。用实际预期输入比较输出质量、延迟和内存。

limits.en: This code demonstrates rounding and assumed stage times, not a hardware benchmark. ONNX Runtime documents real quantization options; not every model or device benefits equally.
limits.zh: 代码演示舍入和假设阶段时间，不是硬件基准。ONNX Runtime 文档介绍真实量化选项；不同模型或设备的收益不同。

takeaway.en: Build reproducible preprocessing and postprocessing around a model. Compare output quality, latency and memory using the actual intended inputs.
takeaway.zh: 围绕模型建立可复现的预处理与后处理。用实际预期输入比较输出质量、延迟和内存。

practice.en: Use the original calculation and Python below to inspect the mechanism. The linked primary sources explain how full systems extend it. The story is an invented teaching scenario.
practice.zh: 用下面的原创计算与 Python 代码观察机制。所链接的一手资料解释完整系统怎样扩展这些机制。故事是虚构的教学情境。

intro.en: Use stated hypothetical times, not measurements.
intro.zh: 使用明确的假设时间，并非实测。

code_examples.code:
values = [0.12, 0.26, 0.91]
step = 0.1
encoded = [round(value / step) for value in values]
restored = [number * step for number in encoded]
errors = [abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(values, restored)]
print("encoded:", encoded)
print("restored:", [round(x, 2) for x in restored])
print(f"largest error={max(errors):.2f}")
print("serial latency ms:", sum([4, 7, 2]))
code_examples.output:
encoded: [1, 3, 9]
restored: [0.1, 0.3, 0.9]
largest error=0.04
serial latency ms: 13

explanation.en: The first comprehension divides and rounds each value. The second reconstructs approximate values by multiplication. zip pairs originals with reconstructions so abs can measure error. Rounding the displayed values to two decimals only affects presentation. sum adds the three assumed stage times. This toy quantizer does not convert or run a trained model.
explanation.zh: 第一个推导式把每个数除以间隔再舍入。第二个通过乘法重建近似数。zip 将原值和重建值配对，abs 测误差。显示时保留两位小数只影响展示。sum 累加三个假设阶段时间。这个教学量化器没有转换或运行训练模型。

title.en: Return a detection box to the original image
title.zh: 把检测框还原到原始图像

intro.en: Mina fits a wide camera image into a square model input. She scales the image and adds padding. The model finds the object, but drawing its coordinates directly on the camera image moves the box. She writes down the actual resized dimensions and padding, reverses those operations, and tests the round trip before trusting the display.
intro.zh: 米娜把宽幅相机图像放入正方形模型输入：先缩放，再补边。模型找到了物体，可直接把模型坐标画回原图时，框却错位了。她记录实际缩放尺寸和补边量，按相反顺序还原坐标，并先做往返测试，再相信显示结果。

code_examples.code:
from math import isclose

def metadata(width, height, side):
    if min(width, height, side) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("positive dimensions required")
    nominal = min(side / width, side / height)
    rw, rh = max(1, round(width * nominal)), max(1, round(height * nominal))
    return rw / width, rh / height, (side - rw) // 2, (side - rh) // 2

def forward(box, meta):
    sx, sy, px, py = meta
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
    return [sx * x1 + px, sy * y1 + py, sx * x2 + px, sy * y2 + py]

def restore(box, meta, width, height):
    sx, sy, px, py = meta
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
    restored = [(x1 - px) / sx, (y1 - py) / sy,
                (x2 - px) / sx, (y2 - py) / sy]
    clipped = [min(max(v, 0.0), limit)
               for v, limit in zip(restored, [width, height, width, height])]
    return clipped if clipped[0] < clipped[2] and clipped[1] < clipped[3] else None

original = [100.0, 50.0, 500.0, 300.0]
meta = metadata(800, 400, 640)
model_box = forward(original, meta)
restored = restore(model_box, meta, 800, 400)
assert all(isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(original, restored))
odd_meta = metadata(853, 480, 640)
odd_back = restore(forward(original, odd_meta), odd_meta, 853, 480)
assert all(isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(original, odd_back))
assert odd_meta[0] != odd_meta[1]  # Rounded height changes the actual y scale.
assert restore([0, 0, 20, 20], meta, 800, 400) is None
print("scale and padding:", meta)
print("model box:", model_box)
print("original box:", restored)
print("rounded-size round trip:", all(isclose(a, b) for a, b in zip(original, odd_back)))
code_examples.output:
scale and padding: (0.8, 0.8, 0, 160)
model box: [80.0, 200.0, 400.0, 400.0]
original box: [100.0, 50.0, 500.0, 300.0]
rounded-size round trip: True

walkthrough.en: An 800 by 400 image becomes 640 by 320. Add 160 pixels above it and 160 below it.
Map both corners. The box [100,50,500,300] becomes [80,200,400,400].
Subtract padding first, then divide by scale. Clip to the original continuous image boundaries.
walkthrough.zh: 先减补边，再除缩放比例，最后裁剪到原图的连续边界。

walkthrough.en: Repeat with 853 by 480. Rounded resized dimensions can give slightly different x and y scales. Reject boxes that collapse inside padding.
walkthrough.zh: 用 853×480 再测一次。取整后的实际尺寸可能导致横纵缩放比例略有不同。完全落在补边中、裁剪后面积为零的框应丢弃。

explanation.en:
For continuous box edges, x_prime=s_x*x+p_x and y_prime=s_y*y+p_y. Here s_x and s_y are actual resized width/original width and resized height/original height. Padding p_x and p_y records the left and top offsets. Reverse the transform with x=(x_prime-p_x)/s_x and y=(y_prime-p_y)/s_y.

In the first image both scales are 0.8. A model y-coordinate of 200 becomes (200-160)/0.8=50. For 853 by 480, rounding produces 640 by 360. Then s_x=640/853 while s_y=360/480. Using the nominal scale for both axes would introduce a small error. Store the actual transform used by preprocessing.

This example uses continuous box edges in [0,width] and [0,height], not integer pixel indices whose last valid values are width-1 and height-1. Real resize libraries can use different pixel-center and interpolation conventions. Cropping, rotation or other padding rules require their own recorded transforms. A round-trip test checks coordinate bookkeeping; it does not prove the detector is accurate.
explanation.zh:
连续框边界满足 x_prime=s_x×x+p_x、y_prime=s_y×y+p_y。s_x 和 s_y 分别是实际缩放后宽度/原宽度、实际缩放后高度/原高度。p_x、p_y 是左侧和顶部补边量。逆变换为 x=(x_prime-p_x)/s_x、y=(y_prime-p_y)/s_y。

第一张图的两个比例都是 0.8。模型中的 y=200 对应原图 (200-160)/0.8=50。853×480 取整后变成 640×360，此时 s_x=640/853，s_y=360/480。两个方向都用名义比例，会引入小误差。应保存预处理实际使用的变换。

本例使用 [0,width]、[0,height] 内的连续框边界，不是最大索引为 width-1、height-1 的整数像素坐标。实际库的像素中心和插值约定可能不同；裁剪、旋转或其他补边规则也需要记录对应变换。往返测试检验坐标记录是否自洽，不能证明检测模型准确。

meaning.en: Making predictions with a model’s current fixed weights.
meaning.zh: 使用当前固定权重作预测。

meaning.en: Time a request waits until its result is ready.
meaning.zh: 一个请求等待结果的时间。

meaning.en: Representing values with a smaller set of possible numbers.
meaning.zh: 用更少种可能数值表示数据。

meaning.en: The number of completed requests per unit time.
meaning.zh: 单位时间完成的请求数量。

question.en: Why measure beyond model computation?
question.zh: 为什么不能只测模型计算？

answer.en: Image preparation and output conversion also delay the result. Users wait for all required steps.
answer.zh: 图像准备和输出转换也消耗时间。用户要等全部必要步骤完成。

question.en: How is 0.26 restored as 0.3?

answer.en: Divide by 0.1 to get 2.6, round to 3, then multiply by 0.1.

question.en: Does lower numeric error guarantee identical labels?
question.zh: 数值误差很小就保证标签相同吗？

answer.en: No. A score near a decision threshold can cross it after a small change.
answer.zh: 不能。靠近决策阈值的分数可能因小变化而跨过阈值。

question.en: Why must padding be removed before division?
question.zh: 为什么先减补边，再除缩放比例？

answer.en: The forward operation scales first and adds padding second. Inverting a sequence reverses its order. Dividing the padding by the wrong scale shifts the box.
answer.zh: 正向先缩放，再加补边。逆运算需要倒转顺序；顺序错误会造成框的偏移。

body.en: Set step to 0.01. These example values reconstruct closely, but a finer grid requires more representable levels over the same range.
body.zh: 将 step 改成 0.01。这些数能更精确重建，但相同范围内需要更多可表示级别。

body.en: Change assumed stage times to [20,4,2]. Speeding the model alone cannot remove the 20 ms preprocessing cost.
body.zh: 把假设时间改成 [20,4,2]。只加速模型无法消除 20 毫秒预处理成本。

title.zh: TorchVision 目标检测微调教程
使用 ResNet-50 主干的 FCN

title.en: Transforming images, videos, boxes and more
title.zh: 变换图像、视频、框等数据

title.en: CS231n: Deep Learning for Computer Vision

title.zh: 一幅图像相当于 16×16 个词

title.en: Metrics and scoring: quantifying prediction quality
title.zh: 指标与评分：量化预测质量
注意力就是你所需要的一切
GroupKFold：组间不重叠的交叉验证

title.en: WILDS: A Benchmark of in-the-Wild Distribution Shifts
title.zh: WILDS：真实环境中的分布偏移基准

title.en: Improving the quality of the output

title.zh: MVTec AD 异常检测数据集

title.en: Benchmark suite: pixel-level IoU and ignored labels
title.zh: 基准评估：像素级 IoU 与忽略标签

title.en: Pixels are measurements with a contract
title.zh: 像素是带有约定的测量值

body.en: Before learning from pixels, establish their axes, colour meaning, scale and normalization contract at every boundary.
body.zh: 在让模型学习像素之前，先明确每个接口的轴顺序、颜色含义、数值尺度与归一化约定。

body.en: Colour filtering can select markers or prepare regions for later inspection. Check known colours, channel order and lighting before trusting a mask.
body.zh: 颜色筛选可选择标牌或为后续检查准备区域。信任掩码前要检查已知颜色、通道顺序与光照。

title.zh: 局部滤波提出局部问题

body.en: A filter is a local question expressed as weights; evaluate what it preserves as carefully as what it removes.
body.zh: 滤波器是用权重表达的局部问题；既要检查它去掉了什么，也要检查它保留了什么。

title.en: Edges and masks: change, then clean
title.zh: 边缘与掩码：先找变化，再清理

body.en: Use these operations to clean scanned text masks or inspect simple shapes. Compare small useful details before and after every cleanup.
body.zh: 可用这些操作清理扫描文字掩码或检查简单形状。每次清理前后都应比较细小但有用的细节。

title.en: Move the picture and its meaning together
title.zh: 让图像与标注一起移动

body.en: Every geometric change must carry its targets along, and every augmentation must justify why the label still means the same thing.
body.zh: 几何变化必须带着标注一起变化；每项增强都要说明，为什么标签含义仍然成立。

title.zh: 局部特征：比较有辨识度的图块

body.en: Local features can support panorama alignment or matching a photographed object to a reference image. Check repeated patterns and geometric agreement.
body.zh: 局部特征可支持全景对齐或将拍摄物体匹配到参考图。需要检查重复图案和几何一致性。

title.en: Borrow a visual vocabulary, then teach a new decision
title.zh: 借用视觉词汇，再学习新的判断

body.en: Transfer a representation, define the new decision carefully, and measure improvement on genuinely separate image groups.
body.zh: 迁移表示，仔细定义新的判断任务，再用真正独立的图像组衡量改进。

title.en: Boxes locate candidates; overlap resolves duplicates
title.zh: 框定位候选对象，重叠度帮助消除重复

body.en: Treat boxes as candidates, define overlap precisely, and validate duplicate removal separately from the rule used to judge detection quality.
body.zh: 把框视为候选，精确定义重叠，并把去重规则与检测质量的判定规则分别验证。

title.en: Detection scores: follow the ranked list
title.zh: 检测分数：顺着排序列表评估

body.en: Use a ranked evaluation to compare detectors under a stated matching protocol. Keep scores, boxes, class labels and reference counts together.
body.zh: 在明确匹配规则下使用排序评估比较检测器。应同时保存分数、框、类别与参考数量。

title.en: From a rectangle to the pixels that belong
title.zh: 从一个矩形走向真正属于对象的像素

body.en: Match the mask to the question, inspect minority foreground, and state exactly how overlap and empty cases are scored.
body.zh: 让掩码类型对应实际问题，检查占少数的前景，并明确重叠度与空掩码情况的评分方式。

body.en: Tracking supports counting moving objects and following toy robots or wildlife through video. Inspect crossings, occlusion and missed detections.
body.zh: 跟踪可用于统计移动物体，或在视频中跟随玩具机器人和野生动物。应检查交叉、遮挡与漏检。

title.en: OCR: turn visible marks into text

body.en: OCR supports searchable scans, labels and document reading. Preserve the image region and reading order so users can check uncertain text.
body.zh: OCR 可用于扫描件搜索、标签识别与文档阅读。应保留原图区域及阅读顺序，便于核对不确定文字。

body.en: Count patches and special tokens explicitly: finer visual units increase possible interactions, while useful detail and actual runtime still require measurement.
body.zh: 明确计算图像块与特殊词元：更细的视觉单元会增加可能的交互，而有用细节与实际运行时间仍需测量。

title.zh: 缺陷检查：发现异常区域

body.en: Use anomaly maps as inspection aids for textures or objects. Keep a distinction between unusual appearance and a confirmed defect.
body.zh: 可用异常图辅助检查纹理或物体。必须区分异常外观与已确认缺陷。

title.en: Test on the next capture, not a familiar neighbour
title.zh: 用下一次采集检验，而非只看熟悉的邻帧

body.en: A trustworthy vision score names its population, separates related captures, and reveals the false positives and missed positives behind the average.
body.zh: 可信的视觉分数应明确目标总体，隔离相关采集记录，并揭示平均值背后的误报与漏报。

title.en: Inference pipelines: preserve the whole journey
title.zh: 推理流程：检查完整处理过程

body.en: Build reproducible preprocessing and postprocessing around a model. Compare output quality, latency and memory using the actual intended inputs.
body.zh: 围绕模型建立可复现的预处理与后处理。用实际预期输入比较输出质量、延迟和内存。
